head: Tiny Computers app: ten retro computers you can type on, on iPhone
dek: Tiny Computers is a 3.99-dollar app with ten miniature retro computers, each with a working screen and keyboard, where you can type commands, draw in paint programs and play desktop games. It was #1 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 23 November.
details: The machines are inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500 and several versions of Windows. Each computer hides five secrets, with hints when you get stuck; version 1.2 on 4 November added the fifty secrets and more realistic screens. On the foldable iPhone Duo, folding the phone into tabletop mode turns it into the computer. The maker, Fountain Interactive, lists no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases, and says it collects no data.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 26.5 or later), also Mac with Apple silicon and Apple Vision; App Store, English
means: If you miss old computers or want to show someone what they looked like, this is a one-off purchase with nothing else to pay.
todo: Find Tiny Computers on the App Store; it costs 3.99 dollars once, and Family Sharing covers up to six people.
thumb_words: TEN RETRO COMPUTERS ON YOUR IPHONE
